answer: In this PoA network, evaluator edges are reciprocity-weighted and propagated through an EigenTrust matrix; reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a half-life, requiring sustained honest service rather than brief activity. A freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted incoming mass, while coordinated self-links cannot pass consensus. River, ferrous, or opal identities remain ineffective without durable, cross-validated trust.
